notes.title: Development progress in September
notes.content:
Visual
23new hairstyles & 17new masks

Some adjustments to map visuals and character styling

7 new filters  
New Buildings
Simple fence:Reliable initial construction, emergency necessities

V-wall:Hanging walls to block high-altitude enemies

Berry potted plants:Too busy fighting to farm? Potted plants will be a good helper!Magic potted plants that automatically grows GGberries when placed

Weapon rack: Place excess weapons
Mysterious
New weapon&refit

New enemy

5 new plants
Features
Portals, "road signs", and altars are installed

Removed the old cumbersome way of obtaining buildings, no longer running back and forth to the initial room, eliminating the process of waiting for production

Removed the restrictions on carrying buildings and selecting NPCs from outside

Overall balance adjustments 

More convenient seed access, optimized planting speed, and increased crop drops

"Vine Device"
Else
Enrich the backstory and do some concept design  

Remastering the newbie guide
Fixes
Fixed an issue where the stacking error was built to control the tiers more precisely  

Shark ruler are still working after replacement(this effect will allow Ran to knock through the stone with his/her body, so let's think of it as a dream)

Fixed material location not refreshing  

Fixed a bug when building previews were destroyed  

Fixed a bug when unlocking new monsters  

Some text shows failed  

Resolved some text flickering issues when refreshing  

Avoid mistakes, disable aerial planting/building

Door failed

Got knocked flying while changing map

And Trivial problems

notes.title: Development progress in August
notes.content:
Visual
Made a big decision: expanded field of view, now Ran have broader perspective  

Added 10 new map decorations 🌿  

UI adjustments for upgrade options to accommodate new weapons and refit


New Weapons
ScarletFoX-890: A mid-to-close-range shotgun with quad-shot trajectory, a balanced performance piece in the Northland Fire series.  

"Carrot": A mid-range light submachine gun with wide spread. Let your enemies eat carrots! (Why carrot?)  

Pick Up GGhen: No one knows if someone sprinting while holding a hen is a good idea, but it happened. The hen will unleash a powerful Cluck! Everyone will revere those who charge into battle while holding a hen!  

Shark ruler: A magical boomerang made of black steel, capable of altering its trajectory with telepathy to clear obstacles. "-The reliable buddy always return." 


New Buildings
Twall:The higher Nwall looks a bit reassuring.

S-S-R:Spines-Shell-Rat! Yes,ssrat comes to help you.Hard shell protects them taking only 1 damage at a time, stabbing all the enemies trying who to pass 2 times.

Unsuspicious Grass pile: The unsuspicious grassy pile has been summoned.Firstly, it is not suspicious at all, secondly, It definitely doesn't look like a trap.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693850/f8159bf2269becd0000b858bc29a45fa926f04db.png"]


Features
Modified and added some monster enhancement options

Enhanced Ran's magic reservoir

When you creating monsters, angels may grant weapons


Refit
ScarletFoX-890: Add 3 new refit

"Carrot":Add 5 new refit

Shark ruler:Add 2 new refit


Fixes
Performance optimization reduces CPU overhead to a certain extent  

Fixed the number of monster summons not being updated based on upgrades, and the wave number was not accumulated  

Fixed an error when obtaining a variant weapon  

Fixed a missing crash for plant rewards  

and a series of fragmentary problems that are difficult to describe
